content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing a similar issue during online testing. The problem seems related to the mapping of VM parameters—specifically, an error occurs whenever two or more variables share the same address. Is it possible to create circular references in [product_name] [version_no]?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Unfortunately, this is not possible. You'll need to manage it manually. Unlike some other systems, there is no cross-reference feature available here.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experiences errors during online testing with [product_name] [version_no] because variable mapping leads to address conflicts. Users are seeking features such as circular references and a cross-reference list for easier variable management, suggesting that current programming capabilities in [product_name] [version_no] do not meet their needs compared to other platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope that [product_name] [version_no] will introduce support for circular references and a cross-reference list to simplify variable mapping and eliminate address conflicts, aiming for smoother assignment and enhanced functionality.
